review_questions: Independently review repaired Slice 7 candidate 022ca352cfc9ccbc37fdab2fbc0ef4c9356120e2. Do not rely on the prior Gemini PASS for c94d8aab9128a5dac418492697bc42992b219a37; deterministic review-of-review found two false-green gaps after that review.

Verify the executor now requires an externally supplied current terminal-authority snapshot plus explicit now_epoch and rejects expired, revoked, not-yet-valid, tampered, replaced, or lineage-mismatched authority before adapter invocation.

Verify a historical hash-valid Slice 6 authorization receipt cannot execute after current authority expires or is revoked, and that CI/model/reviewer/conversation state cannot substitute for use-time authority.

Verify the terminal adapter is no longer a plain callable: it must implement durable recover(terminal_execution_id,binding_hash) and execute_once(terminal_execution_id,binding_hash,binding) semantics and reject identity rebinding.

Adversarially inspect the crash window after the adapter durably applies a side effect but before the executor commits local completion. Verify retry/reopen recovers the durable adapter result and does not apply a second side effect.
Inspect S7-22..S7-30 specifically, including the preserved failing defect-exposure candidate 78bda890a34d4ada78236882d17a24a1a4c42fa4 where the Option B suite failed before mechanism repair.
Verify completion evidence binds authority_snapshot_hash in addition to Slice 6 receipt hash and exact project/task/effect/action/artifact/state-version lineage.
Verify adapter failure/self-report cannot widen target/action or launder failure into completion, and that local COMPLETED/REPLAYED/RECOVERED states do not claim a real production side effect.
Verify exact-head CI run 34321684000 is execution evidence only: S7-01..S7-30 plus accepted Slice 1→6 regressions passed on exact candidate 022ca352cfc9ccbc37fdab2fbc0ef4c9356120e2.

Search for any remaining authority freshness, idempotency, crash/retry, stale-state, claimant-controlled, or false-green path within the amended frozen reference scope. Return an independent disposition based only on the exact repaired candidate and materialized evidence.

evidence_refs.ref: Pre-amendment candidate c94d8aab9128a5dac418492697bc42992b219a37 passed S7-01..S7-21 and authenticated Gemini review REV-MVP-SLICE7-TERMINAL-EXECUTOR-002 returned PASS, but deterministic review-of-review found two uncovered defects: no use-time current-authority freshness/revocation input, and no protection for crash after external adapter side-effect success but before local completion commit. That PASS has authority_effect NONE.

Option B defect-exposure candidate 78bda890a34d4ada78236882d17a24a1a4c42fa4 preserved original S7-01..S7-21 PASS while S7-22..S7-30 failed because TerminalExecutor lacked the current_authority/now_epoch interface. Mechanism repair began only afterward.

required_review_dimensions.description: Exact valid Slice 6 receipt remains necessary and request lineage cannot be substituted.
Current authority snapshot and explicit current time are validated at terminal use time; expired/revoked/not-yet-valid/replaced authority fails closed.
Authority snapshot is self-hash bound and exactly matches authority id, project/task/effect/action/artifact/state-version.
Current project/state version/artifact still match immediately before terminal execution.
Adapter protocol durably binds terminal execution identity to one exact binding/result and rejects rebinding.
Crash after durable adapter effect but before local completion cannot duplicate the side effect on retry/reopen.
Crash after local durable completion but before response recovers without duplicate execution.
Concurrent identical requests converge to one durable adapter side effect/result.
Adapter failure/self-report cannot widen bound fields or mint successful completion.
Completion evidence binds Slice 6 receipt hash, authority snapshot hash, exact lineage, adapter-result digest, and deterministic completion hash.
Model, worker, reviewer, green CI, and conversation state cannot replace current terminal authority or effect evidence.
Reference completion never claims a real production merge/release/deploy/completion occurred.
Accepted Slice 1→6 boundaries remain preserved on the exact repaired candidate.
Adversarial review finds no remaining false-green/stale-authority/idempotency/crash claimant-controlled bypass within frozen scope.
